title: INSANE AUTO FUSE AUTO FARM AUTO PICKUP
features:
🚜 Auto Farm
Auto collect earnings, auto upgrade Beanstalk, auto rebirth, auto server hop, and noclip movement.

🎒 Auto Pick Up
Auto collect wild pets with zone selection (Zone 1–7 or All), mutation filter (All / Any / Normal / Specific), rarity filter, and pet name filter.
Includes auto return base, and guard NPC removal.

🧪 Auto Fuse
AI fusion system that can target specific Divine/Secret pets or auto fuse weakest pets.
Supports mutation protection and auto claim results.

📡 Scanner
Real-time map scanner showing all wild pets with mutations, base rate, and earnings.
Auto refresh every 0.5s and allows instant teleport pickup from the list.
